notes: Sequential current-production, instrumented, current-production sweeps. Each requests 1G, 4G, 21G and unlimited per direction for twenty seconds, using the same QinQ profile as preceding reports.

Instrumentation is diagnostic only: exact granted/submitted bytes and epochs, occupancy peaks and window constraints; existing timestamps measure busy-owner/grant intervals. One extra clock per 64 owner passes and per 64 grants per worker samples wall duration and completion timing.
Window-insufficient and window-limited counts are necessary window constraints, not exclusive blocker attribution. Burst, pacing, accounting phases or other blockers may coexist.
Peak metrics are lifetime gauges, not deltas or sums. Grant intervals include idle gaps; busy intervals require both adjacent owner entries to have a pending request.

Reservation-to-report means use service_report_samples, including zero-success completions. Reservation-to-send and send-to-report means use service_send_samples, only successful sampled completions. Owner-call wall time includes preemption and is not CPU duty.
No local compilation, local kernel tests, live snapshots or Git packing overlapped measurement. Failure-only migration tests ran on another machine.
Goodput excludes drain; missing fractions and counters include drain. CPU100% means one core. Instrumentation can perturb scheduling, so production is measured before and after.
All instrumented points have zero corrupt/duplicate/wrong-run/too-old records, inner/outer UDP errors, outer socket overflow, fragments and reordered records.
